question: If the correlation coefficient is zero, then the angle between the two lines of regression is:
solution:
The correct answer is** π/2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• If the correlation coefficient between two variables is zero, then the angle between the two lines of regression is &pi
